claim.summary: Top-window twist scalarity: over any field, for the product pigeonhole system with Boolean axioms (hole axioms x_ij x_kj, pigeon axioms prod_j(1-x_ij), R=k[x]) with m >= 2 pigeons and n >= 2 holes, J its degree-n closure, and a twisted repair nu (lem:twist-window-trade's definition) at window n with room <= n whose twisted variables are hole variables on distinct pigeons and distinct holes: T = 1, deg nu = 0, rho(x)nu = x nu for every twisted x, and rho(g)nu = g nu for every g; such a repair exists exactly when the weight w is a repair (w not in C, wE_i in C). Proof: soundness at the pigeon axiom of x's pigeon, read on Y modulo the unplaced-pigeon indicators (cor:hole-occupancy-kernels (d), valid with Boolean axioms by lem:top-degree-axiom-inertness), and at the hole axioms through x force rho(x)nu = x nu. False at n = 1. On 3 pigeons, 2 holes, no repair of this class with weight x00 kills x11.

claim.summary: Over any field, for the product pigeonhole system (m pigeons, n>=1 holes, multilinear ring) at degree D<=n and errors E_j of degree <=e, in the inert range (K+e<=D<n, or K+e<=n-1 at D=n): restriction to the set Y of hole-respecting assignments identifies V_K/(C cap V_K) with V_K|_Y, the common kernel with the zero set of restriction to the union S of the supports on Y, and the stacked rank with dim V_K|_S. If S = A x (all states of the other n-t holes), dim V_K|_S = sum_{s<=K} binom(n-t,s) m^s d_A(K-s), d_A(a)=dim V_a|_A; a monomial on e distinct holes has kernel dimension sum_{k<=K}[binom(n,k)-binom(n-e,k)] m^k, and the common kernel of x_(i,0), i in a set of size sigma, at K=1 has dimension m+1-sigma. At D=n, c of degree <=n lies in C iff c|_Y is in the span P_Y of the unplaced-pigeon indicators; for K+e<=n and K<=n-1 the stacked rank lies between dim V_K|_S - sum_j dim P_Y^{S_j} and dim V_K|_S.

(a) With Boolean axioms on x_1..x_t, rho(x_i)=x_i I for i>t and room T(D-K)+deg nu<=D': rho(g)nu = rho(g|x1=0)u_0+rho(g|x1=1)u_1, and for deg g<=D-K-1 membership splits, so a vector u_eps is a twisted repair of the substituted map at window D-K-1 (soundness and killing of degree D-K dropped), room unchanged; after t splits some coordinate of some u_sigma is a substitution repair of x_1..x_t at window D-K-(t-s) when the room is T(D-K)+sT+deg nu. (b) If x_1..x_s are twisted, rho(x_i)=x_i I for i>s, each x_i-l_i is an axiom with l_i of degree <=1 in untwisted variables, and D-K+deg nu<=D', then rho(g)nu = g nu mod J^k for deg g<=D-K: a scalar repair at the full window, with no Boolean axiom and no entry bound. (c) In a domain model (J the degree-<=D' polynomials vanishing on finite X), with x_1^2-x_1 an axiom and D-K>=2, the split pieces of every g of degree <=D-K vanish on X with degree <=T(D-K)+T+deg nu: the full window is kept, measured at degree D'+T, survival unchanged.

claim.summary: Over any field, for the product pigeonhole system with m pigeons and n holes (multilinear ring or Boolean axioms) at its top degree D=n, Y the hole-respecting assignments, x=x_ab a hole variable, S a set of variables other than x, P = {x_kb: k!=a} union S and 1<=K'<=n-1: F = {f of degree <=K': p f in C for p in P} has a member outside C iff tau<=K', tau the number of distinct holes the variables of P lie in; then, if hole b is touched (b in H, e.g. m>=2), x prod_{j in H minus b}(1-sum_k x_kj), H the touched holes, lies in F minus C, a scalar repair x m with deg m = tau-1. Consequently, at any window W>=2 with room TW+deg nu<=n, a twisted repair with one twisted variable x, weight x and variable errors S (K'=T+deg nu<=n-1) implies, with b in H, a scalar repair with multiplier degree tau-1<=T+deg nu-1 for the same errors, at most deg nu when T=1 (necessary direction, via the pair identity of lem:twist-window-trade).

claim.summary: Over any field (multilinear ring, or Boolean axioms among G), let G and P be finite sets of polynomials, H the degree-D PC closure of G, P_D the members of P of degree exactly D, and every member of P of degree >= D. The degree-D closure of G with P equals H + span P_D, with the same members of degree below D as H, if and only if (H + span P_D) cap V_{D-1} lies in H; it suffices that the degree-D parts of P_D are linearly independent modulo the degree-D parts of members of H. For the product pigeonhole system over any field (pigeon axioms prod_j(1-x_ij) of degree n, hole axioms) and D <= n, H is the degree-D part of the vanishing ideal of the hole-respecting assignments and the closure's members of degree below D are those of H.

claim.summary: For the product pigeonhole system (m pigeons, n>=1 holes) at D=n over any field, an error E of degree e with K+e<=n and support S_E on the hole-respecting assignments Y: if the unplaced-pigeon indicators restricted to Y minus S_E are linearly independent, then for f of degree <=K, fE lies in the closure exactly when f vanishes on S_E. The independence holds when Y minus S_E contains the empty assignment and, for each pigeon, an assignment placing only it; it also holds for every monomial error of degree e>=1 on distinct holes, for all m and n (at n=1 by a separate argument). For K+e<=n-1 the conclusion needs no hypothesis; the content is K+e=n. With lem:cylinder-killer-degree, the six errors x_jj x_ll on the hole pairs at m=5, n=4, D=4, K=2 have no surviving common killer of degree 2, the least degree being tau(K_4)=3.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer of the cylinder-killers entry with a follow-up (review record in research/results/common_multiplier_cylinder_killers_20261016); "the closure" is the degree-n PC closure of the product pigeonhole system, as in the entry.
